options.text: The guest has canceled an interview.
Some photographs are out of focus.
options.whyZh: 照片尚待選擇，沒有品質問題。

options.text: The recording has poor sound quality.
The interview is too long for one episode.
options.zh: 訪談超過通常一集的長度。
options.whyZh: 錄音比平時一集長十二分鐘，但 Ben 不想刪掉實用例子。

explanationZh: 錄音比平時一集長十二分鐘，但 Ben 不想刪掉實用例子。
evidence: the recording is twelve minutes longer than our usual episode
